title: Monkey D. Luffy
text: Monkey D. Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and the main protagonist. He dreams of becoming the Pirate King by finding the legendary treasure, One Piece. Luffy gained the ability to stretch his body like rubber after eating the Gum-Gum Fruit.

title: Roronoa Zoro
text: Roronoa Zoro is the first crewmate to join Luffy in East Blue. He is a master swordsman who uses the unique Three-Sword Style. His ambition is to become the greatest swordsman in the world.

title: Nami
text: Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates, skilled in reading weather and maps. She initially joins with secret motives but later becomes loyal to Luffy’s dream. Her goal is to draw a map of the entire world.

title: Usopp
text: Usopp is the sniper of the crew, known for his creativity and lies that sometimes turn true. Though cowardly at times, he shows great bravery when it matters most. His dream is to become a brave warrior of the sea.

title: Sanji
text: Sanji is the Straw Hat’s cook and a skilled fighter who uses only his legs in combat. He dreams of finding the All Blue, a legendary sea containing every kind of fish. Sanji is also a gentleman, especially toward women.

title: Tony Tony Chopper
text: Tony Tony Chopper is the crew’s doctor and a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit. He can transform into different forms combining human and animal traits. Chopper dreams of becoming a doctor who can cure any disease.

title: Nico Robin
text: Nico Robin is the archaeologist of the Straw Hats who can sprout extra limbs using the Flower-Flower Fruit. She seeks the Rio Poneglyph, which reveals the true history of the world. Robin is calm, intelligent, and mysterious.

title: Franky
text: Franky is the shipwright of the Straw Hats and a cyborg powered by cola. He built the Thousand Sunny, the crew’s current ship. Franky dreams of building a ship that will sail around the world.

title: Brook
text: Brook is the musician of the Straw Hat Pirates and a living skeleton due to the Revive-Revive Fruit. He fights with a sword and music that can influence emotions. His dream is to reunite with Laboon, a whale waiting at Reverse Mountain.

title: Jinbe
text: Jinbe is a fish-man and the helmsman of the Straw Hats. He is a former Warlord of the Sea and skilled in Fish-Man Karate. His dream is to bring peace and equality between humans and fish-men.

title: Marineford War
text: The Marineford War is a major battle between the Whitebeard Pirates and the Marines. It begins as a rescue attempt for Ace but escalates into a massive conflict that changes the balance of power. The war ends with the death of Whitebeard and Ace.

title: Yonko
text: The Yonko are the four most powerful pirate captains in the world. Each controls vast territories in the New World and commands enormous crews. They represent one of the greatest threats to the World Government.

title: Shichibukai
text: The Shichibukai were seven powerful pirates allied with the World Government. They were allowed to continue pirating in exchange for serving the Marines when needed. The system was later abolished due to abuse and corruption.

title: Haki
text: Haki is a mysterious spiritual power present in every living being. It has three main forms: Observation (enhanced senses and prediction), Armament (offensive and defensive hardening), and Conqueror’s (intimidating willpower). Only a few can master all three.

title: Devil Fruits
text: Devil Fruits grant supernatural powers at the cost of the ability to swim. They are categorized into three types: Paramecia, Zoan, and Logia. Each fruit is unique, and once eaten, its power cannot be duplicated until the user dies.
